<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/pricing-more.ts -->
<!--
  Packs of credits as tiles: the amount, a badge, the price and a buy button. Axes: columns (2, 4), item (tile,
  row), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Pack } from "./credit-packs.types";

  export type CreditPacksProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    packs: Pack[];
    badges: Record<string, string>;
    buy: string;
    cols?: "2" | "4";
    item?: "tile" | "row";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { at, cn, fitCols, fmtMoney } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    packs,
    badges,
    buy,
    cols = "4",
    item = "tile",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: CreditPacksProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  measure={(((item as string) === "row") ? "2xl" : "default")}
>
  <Grid
    cols={
      (item as string) === "row" ? "1"
      : fitCols((((cols as string) === "2") ? "1-2" : "1-4"), (packs?.length ?? 0))
    }
    class="gap-4"
    data-testid="items"
  >
    {#each packs as pack (pack.id)}
      <Card
        variant="default"
        class={cn(
          "h-full",
          (
            (item as string) === "row" ? "gap-4 p-4"
            : (density as string) === "compact" ? "gap-4 p-4"
            : ""
          )
        )}
        data-testid="item"
        data-badge={pack.badge}
      >
        <CardContent
          class={cn(
            "flex h-full gap-4",
            (((item as string) === "row") ? "flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between" : "flex-col")
          )}
        >
          <Stack gap="2" align="start" class={cn("min-w-0", (((item as string) === "row") ? "flex-1" : ""))}>
            {#if (pack.badge || (((item as string) !== "row") && (packs.filter((i) => i["badge"]).length > 0)))}
              <Box class="flex min-h-6 items-center" data-slot="badge-slot">
                {#if pack.badge}
                  <Badge variant="default" size="default" class="w-fit shrink-0" data-testid="badge">
                    {at(badges, pack.badge)}
                  </Badge>
                {/if}
              </Box>
            {/if}
            <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0">
              <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
                {pack.name}
              </Title>
              <Text size="2xl" weight="bold">
                {fmtMoney(pack.price, pack.currency)}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
          <Button
            variant={((pack.badge === "popular") ? "default" : "outline")}
            size="sm"
            type="button"
            class={cn("w-fit shrink-0", (((item as string) === "row") ? "" : "mt-auto"))}
            data-testid="buy"
          >
            {buy}
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
